headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: May 24, 2026**
article:
The St. Louis Cardinals continued their winning streak with an 8-1 victory over the Cincinnati Reds, led by Jordan Walker's home run and three RBIs. In a thrilling finish, the Reds edged the Cardinals 7-6, with Jordan Walker contributing three hits, including a home run, and four RBIs.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, affecting their teams' lineups. The Washington Nationals placed Jake Irvin on the 15-day injured list due to a right shoulder strain. The Chicago Cubs' Edward Cabrera was placed on the 15-day injured list retroactive to May 21, 2026, with a right middle-finger blister. Other injured players include Jonny DeLuca (Tampa Bay Rays), Brant Hurter (Detroit Tigers), Lourdes Gurriel Jr. (Arizona Diamondbacks), Carter Baumler (Texas Rangers), Jordan Hicks (Chicago White Sox), and Mickey Moniak (Colorado Rockies).

Several trades and roster moves have taken place. The Philadelphia Phillies traded RHP Andrew Baker to the Colorado Rockies for future considerations and international bonus pool money. The Cincinnati Reds traded RF Rece Hinds to the Miami Marlins for RHP Zach McCambley. The Tampa Bay Rays traded LHP Joe Rock to the Chicago White Sox for 3B Oliver Dunn, while the Toronto Blue Jays traded LHP Eric Lauer to the Los Angeles Dodgers for cash.

top_news.title: **Cardinals Cruise Past Reds 8-1**
top_news.summary: The St. Louis Cardinals dominated the Cincinnati Reds, securing an 8-1 victory. Jordan Walker led the Cardinals' offense with a home run and three RBIs.

top_news.title: **Reds Edge Cardinals in Thrilling Finish**
top_news.summary: The Cincinnati Reds secured a 7-6 victory over the St. Louis Cardinals in a closely contested game. Jordan Walker led the Cardinals' offense with 3 hits, including a home run, and 4 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Astros Shut Out Cubs 3-0**
top_news.summary: The Houston Astros secured a shutout victory over the Chicago Cubs, winning 3-0. Christian Walker led the Astros' offense with a 3-for-3 performance, including two home runs and three RBIs.

top_news.title: **Pirates Fall to Blue Jays in Toronto**
top_news.summary: The Toronto Blue Jays defeated the Pittsburgh Pirates 5-2, with Patrick Corbin earning the win after 6.0 innings of work, striking out 7 and allowing just 1 earned run.

top_news.title: **Pirates Take Down Blue Jays 4-1**
top_news.summary: The Pittsburgh Pirates secured a 4-1 victory over the Toronto Blue Jays, led by strong performances from impact hitters Spencer Horwitz, Oneil Cruz, and Esmerlyn Valdez. Dylan Cease was instrumental in the win, contributing as an impact pitcher.

top_news.title: **Tigers Fall to Orioles in 3-5 Showdown**
top_news.summary: The Baltimore Orioles secured a 3-5 victory over the Detroit Tigers, with Matt Vierling and Gunnar Henderson leading the Orioles' offense. Colton Cowser also contributed to the Orioles' win.

top_news.title: **Nationals' Jake Irvin Lands on Injured List**
top_news.summary: Washington Nationals right-handed pitcher Jake Irvin has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to a right shoulder strain.

top_news.title: **Phillies Make Roster Move Ahead of Sunday's Game**
top_news.summary: The Philadelphia Phillies have traded RHP Andrew Baker to the Colorado Rockies in exchange for Future Considerations and International Bonus Pool Money.
